open_issues: SetupWriteRequest.Kdf is internal to Wakeel.Crypto (InternalsVisibleTo names only Wakeel.Crypto.Tests), so my suites cannot lower the derivation cost for the PACKAGE password. Every exported or inspected .wakeel-setup in tests/Wakeel.Walkthrough.Tests and tests/Wakeel.UI.Tests therefore pays one real Argon2id derivation (~0.4-0.6 s). Account-password cost IS lowered via AccountOptions.Kdf. If the crypto owner adds Wakeel.Walkthrough.Tests and Wakeel.UI.Tests to that InternalsVisibleTo list, both suites get roughly 20 s faster; I did not edit Wakeel.Crypto.csproj because it is outside my allowed paths.

Drag-and-drop of a .wakeel-setup file onto the window (MainWindow.HandleDragOver/HandleDrop -> SetupFileDrop -> W02) is wired and compiles, but I could only verify the file-picker half at runtime: a WPF drag-and-drop cannot be synthesised through CDP, and the drop is handled by the WPF window rather than the page. Needs a human drag once.

Wakeel.Desktop and Wakeel.Admin both accept --remote-debugging-port and both are being driven at 9333 by default. While B1-A's host was running, my CDP client attached to ITS window and I captured an admin screen believing it was mine. Nothing was broken by it, but the acceptance harness should give each host its own port (I used 9351 for the final runs).

W07's QR scan path is tested with pixels the test draws itself (QrImageReader + ZXing round trip). The actual PNG/JPEG decoding is WindowsImagePixels, which needs WPF imaging and so cannot run in a net10.0 test project; it is exercised only when the host runs, and I did not have a photographed sheet to feed it.

I added two registration lines to tests/Wakeel.UI.Tests/WakeelTestContext.cs (AddWakeelCore + AddWakeelAccount). That file is shared, and the brief said 'additions only' for that project — these are additions, nothing was removed or rewritten, but it was unavoidable: MainLayout now hosts W06LockOverlay, so every existing ShellTests render needed AccountSession in the container.
notes:
INVENTORY AT RESTART: the screens, the 18 account services, InstallationService and Ar.FirstRun.cs were already on disk and compiled; Wakeel.Desktop had 4 compile errors; the walkthrough project had no tests; there were no bUnit tests for the six screens; the host had never been run (App.xaml.cs registered none of the account services, so /first-run could not have resolved a single one).

FOUR REAL BUGS FOUND AND FIXED (not cosmetics):
1. InstallationService.CreateAsync wrote installation, org_units, devices and account in one SaveChanges. WakeelDb declares no navigations between those tables, so EF ordered the inserts arbitrarily while SQLite has foreign_keys=ON — every activation died with "FOREIGN KEY constraint failed". Units are now written parents-first (OrderedUnits, which also survives a self-referencing loop) and staged before the device, inside the same transaction.
2. SetupInspectionService.BuildSummary read SetupPackage.Content, whose getter calls EnsureAcceptable(). On any refused file — wrong device, older export, future date — W03 threw instead of drawing. It now reads package.Description (the part Wakeel.Crypto deliberately exposes for exactly this) and ReadLogoPreviewFromRejectedFile, so a refused file still names its organisation and shows its logo while its seeds and office key stay sealed. That is what lets a person see the file was meant for someone else.
3. The InputFile of W02 and W07 sat outside the component's scoped-CSS reach (Blazor does not stamp a child component's markup), so opacity:0 never applied and the browser's English "No file chosen / Choose File" chrome was printed across an Arabic screen. Fixed with ::deep; verified live (opacity=0, position=absolute).
4. ".wakeel-setup" inside an Arabic sentence rendered with its dot at the wrong end — the leading dot is a neutral between Arabic and a Latin run, so RTL pushed it across. Added Ar.FirstRun.SetupExtensionInline, which puts the dot INSIDE the U+2066/U+2069 isolate; Bidi.Wrap cannot do this because it anchors tokens on alphanumerics so it never swallows sentence punctuation. Verified by measuring the rendered rects: dot 715..718, word 718..800.

DESIGN DECISIONS: MainLayout hosts W06LockOverlay and resets the idle timer on any click/key/pointer in the shell; its user menu's «قفل الجهاز» and «تسجيل الخروج» are now wired to LockService/AccountSession, and the top bar names the signed-in employee and role instead of the sample identity (falling back to the sample before anyone signs in). The host reads --data-folder before anything opens a file, because the log folder is chosen from it. WebView2PrintService uses ShowPrintUI (this SDK has no ShowPrintUIAsync), so «طباعة» honestly reports only that the sheet was handed to the printer — the Arabic already said «أُرسلت إلى الطابعة».

WALKTHROUGH: one FirstRunWorld plays both sides — SetupPackageWriter stands in for the admin tool, the account services play الوكيل — on a temp root. The full path asserts database rows (installation identity, 4 org_units, 1 device, settings incl. letter-template document id, 4 documents), files on disk (installation.key with all four wrap kinds for both keys, staging deleted), audit_log entries per step, and sweeps every byte the installation wrote for the passwords and both recovery codes in UTF-8, UTF-16 and base64. Plus the five refusal states, the lock-out, and both recovery variants.

SCREEN-BY-SCREEN FIDELITY (host run over CDP, 1366x768, own --data-folder):
- W02 /first-run (light + dark): brand block, 3-step rail with step 2 marked current, signed-package notice, drop zone doubling as picker, package password with reveal, «فحص الحزمة», «أين أجد الملف؟» tooltip, dated footer. Matches the spec. Chosen-file row with name/size/date appears after a file is given.
- W03 /first-run/check (dark): 12 live check lines each with an Arabic verdict, «جاهزة للتفعيل» chip, timestamp, org card with logo/role/employee/device/office code, binding notice, «تفعيل هذه النسخة» / «اختيار حزمة أخرى» / «إعادة الفحص». Refusal states verified in tests (card still names the org, activate disabled, failure dialog).
- W04 /first-run/account (dark): step chips, identity card, password + strength meter + the four rules, confirm, recovery sheet shown once with code and QR, «طباعة» / «حفظ PDF» (enabled — real WebView2 printer) and the Ctrl+P hint, «طبعتُ ورقة الاسترداد...» checkbox gating «ابدأ العمل». Pressing it wrote installation.key and wakeel.db and emptied staging.
- W05 /login (light + dark): org logo, name, office, employee avatar and name, «مدير المكتب • الموظف رقم 2 • الجهاز 1», password with show/hide, «دخول», «نسيت كلمة المرور؟ استخدم ورقة الاسترداد», clock chip «ساعة الجهاز سليمة • الأربعاء 16/09/2026 — 15:02», version/device footer. Startup route decision verified both ways (empty -> /first-run, activated -> /login); /gallery still reachable.
- W06 (dark): locked from the user menu; the overlay lies over W08 with the lock mark, «قُفلت الجلسة», the idle sentence with the time, the identity card, password, «متابعة», the Enter hint and the drafts-saved note. The right password reopened it; a wrong one keeps it locked.
- W07 (dark): the wrong-password state on W05 shows the field in error plus «المحاولة 1 من 5 • بقيت 4 محاولات قبل الإيقاف المؤقت 15 دقيقة» with the dot row; the recovery dialog shows the two steps, «إدخال الرمز» / «مسح QR», the 21-character field, new password + confirm + strength, the optional new sheet with its consequence line, and the «ما الذي سيحدث» notice.
No Latin letters anywhere in the chrome except the owner-sanctioned QR / PDF / v0.21 / the file extension, each isolated. Host log clean: no exceptions, and neither password nor the package password appears in it.
